devdoc.author: NFTfi
devdoc.details: This contract is an implementation of the IRefinancingAdapter for the Blend platform. It handles operations related to refinancing Blend loans such as transferring the borrower role, paying off loans, and retrieving loan and collateral details.

getBorrowerAddress(address,uint256,bytes.details: Gets the address of the borrower for a specific Blend loan.

params._extraData: The ABI-encoded Lien struct containing loan details from Blend. This data must be retrieved from events as Blend does not provide a direct query method.

returns._0: address of the borrower from the encoded Lien struct.

getCollateral(address,uint256,bytes).details: Gets the NFT collateral information for a specific Blend loan.

params._extraData: The ABI-encoded Lien struct containing loan details from Blend.

returns._0: nftCollateralContract The address of the NFT collection contract.
returns._1: nftCollateralId The token ID of the NFT used as collateral.

getPayoffDetails(address,uint256,bytes).details: Gets the payoff details for a specific Blend loan.

params._extraData: The ABI-encoded Lien struct containing loan details from Blend.

returns._0: loanERC20Denomination The address of the payoff token (always WETH for Blend).
returns._1: maximumRepaymentAmount The total amount required to pay off the loan, calculated based on the principal, interest rate, and time elapsed since loan creation.

payOffRefinancable(address,uint256,addre.details: Pays off a Blend loan as part of the refinancing process.

params._extraData: The ABI-encoded Lien struct containing the loan details needed for repayment.
params._loanContract: The address of the Blend contract.
params._loanIdentifier: The lien ID of the Blend loan.
params._payBackAmount: The amount of WETH tokens used to pay back the Blend loan.

returns._0: A boolean value indicating whether the operation was successful.

transferBorrowerRole(address,uint256,byt.details: Handles the borrower role transfer for Blend loans.

returns._0: Always returns true as no additional action is required.

devdoc.title: BlendRefinancingAdapter

getPayoffDetails(address,uint256,bytes).notice: This function calculates the current debt including accrued interest at the moment of calling. We are using the exact logic from Blend's computeCurrentDebt function

payOffRefinancable(address,uint256,addre.notice: This function unwraps WETH to ETH, deposits it to the Blur pool, and calls Blend's repay function with the lien details.

transferBorrowerRole(address,uint256,byt.notice: For Blend, no borrower role transfer is possible, unused function
